title: Bone Crack
blurb: A crisp skeletal crunch that makes a whole room wince before anyone has decided to. Sound designers worked out decades ago that the crack sells the injury far better than any visual does, and celery snapped near a microphone has broken more limbs on screen than any stunt team ever managed. So it lands on stretches that go slightly too well, on falls that land wrong, on any physical event the viewer ought to feel in their own body. Sympathetic pain, chiropractic content, full-body cringe — nobody hears this comfortably.
origin: A crisp cartilage-and-bone crunch for maximum wince.
